value.rationale: Two uniform integer block-average projections arise canonically from a published Hardy weighted-composition semigroup; their mutual compatibility and entire spectrum are natural, nontrivial operator invariants. The modular path identity classifies every pair, proves the exact divisibility obstruction and all essential spectral values, gives a closed congruence-family formula and residue-dependent sharp scale-separation coefficient. These are substantive structural statements, not a special case of generic angles without the new arithmetic eigenvalue computation. The setting is restricted to unshifted uniform blocks; broader partition families remain open.
